data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: implicit_assumption): dispatch_arbiter must handle agent-returned rulings array length mismatch with input findings array. Rules: (1) length mismatch (e.g., agent returned 3 rulings for 5 findings) → treat as dispatch failure, trigger T2 fail-closed BLOCK synthesis for ALL input findings; (2) ruling entries with finding_hash not matching any input finding are dropped + logged as 'arbiter_orphan_ruling finding_hash=<h>'; (3) input findings with no matching ruling entry trigger fail-closed BLOCK for that specific finding. Add test_dispatch_arbiter_length_mismatch_triggers_fail_closed and test_dispatch_arbiter_orphan_ruling_dropped.
